Because strong coffee does not let you sleep.
What a silly joke, but very funny.
Maxim, forgive me for interfering right now.
But I have two pieces of news for you.
One piece of news is good, and the other is bad.
Then let us start with the good one, Rodion Sergeyevich.
Katya undoubtedly likes you very much.
Some good news that is. And what is the bad one?
You have a terrible sense of humor, Maxim.

examples.text: Здравствуйте всем! Я ваш новый редактор культуры.
examples.trans: Hello everyone! I am your new culture editor.

examples.text: Но людям также нужна высокая культура!
examples.trans: But people also need high culture!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Он всегда точно знает, что делать.
examples.trans: He always knows exactly what to do.

examples.text: По признакам всё точно сходится.
examples.trans: By the signs, everything matches up.

examples.text: Они этого точно не дождутся!
examples.trans: They definitely won't get that!
